name: projects-sql
title: projects-sql
description: projects-sql's view: Provides projects: one actor per project (its record, members with one owner, instructions and documents with every version and full-text search, links, an append-only change log with exact restore) and a directory actor, over storage.sql; every call checked against its caller; removed projects purged after 30 days. Admin routes and a dashboard view for operators. Its admin API routes come with the component (pikit add projects-sql).
